statement: The record lists sector 7 as “open” but also gives a flight ban from 12:00 to 23:00 today, so it does not support committing SV-19 during the ban.
judge_text:
WRONG

It flags the record's internal contradiction — "lists sector 7 as 'open' but also gives a flight ban" — and concludes it "does not support committing SV-19 during the ban."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
